copy.curiosityHook: When a secure foreign outpost is attacked, can an outside investigative team navigate unfamiliar ground to uncover who orchestrated the strike?
copy.description: Directed by Peter Berg, this thriller follows a specialized team of U.S. government agents dispatched to the Middle East to investigate a devastating bombing at an American facility.
copy.vibeSummary: Tense, serious, and fast-escalating procedural action best suited for focused, solitary viewing.
copy.whyWatch: Peter Berg anchors an explosive procedural thriller with visceral action and somber drama, delivering a high-stakes investigation driven by urgent tension.

allowedMaterial: A team of U.S. government agents investigates a bombing at an American facility in the Middle East
Genres include Action, Drama, and Thriller
Serious, heavy stakes and tense procedural momentum
excludedMaterial: Identity of the bombers or masterminds
Specific casualties, deaths, or third-act resolutions
